missing.what_was_said: Management reported a 67.1% full-year 2021 efficiency ratio and explicitly said the 69%–72% range had been beaten: “We obviously beat that.” This establishes earlier attainment, not just reaffirmation.

Management reported a 73.2% full-year 2022 efficiency ratio, or 72.4% excluding integration-related expenses. It also said averaging 2021 and 2022 put the ratio “right at 70%.” These results qualify the picture of continuous progress.

Management reported a 77.2% full-year 2023 efficiency ratio. In discussing the presentation of its long-term goals without the previous less-than sign, management described the 70% goal as a reaffirmation, while cautioning that achievement would take time and favorable economic conditions.
